name: Alpha-Blended Cloud Rendering with Occlusion
aliases: Noise-Clipped Cloud Rendering with Approximate SSS
definition: A fragment shader technique for rendering volumetric clouds using alpha blending, incorporating 3D noise clipping, subsurface scattering (SSS), view brightening, and occlusion mixing with opaque scene objects via depth texture sampling.
summary: Alpha-Blended Cloud Rendering with Occlusion is a fragment-based technique that uses 3D noise and alpha clipping for shading, distinguished by its depth-aware occlusion system that allows clouds to interact with opaque geometry.
